tools.name: validate_hire
tools.description: Validate one hire's records across Ashby (source), Workday, Okta, ExpoIT and the cohort tracker, including deadline gates. Returns PASS/REVIEW/BLOCKED with issues, owners and suggested actions. Read-only and idempotent.

as_of.description: Optional evaluation date YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the configured date

tools.name: list_open_exceptions
tools.description: List all hires and orphan (off-cycle) records whose status is not PASS, with error and warning counts. Read-only.
